ceu: ✦ The trine between Venus and Saturn

s.k: Look after your nest and the people in it.
t: Today your heart pulls you indoors. A quiet dinner or some tidying at home will do you good.

The trine between Venus and Saturn brings together, in your favour, your horizons and your image: Venus brings affection and harmony, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Put your heart and your head on the same side.
s.d: Phone an older relative and listen to them without hurry.

s.k: The right words open doors today.
t: With the Moon in your house of communication, a word said at the right moment can clear up a misunderstanding.

The trine between Venus and Saturn brings together, in your favour, intimacy and your inner life: Venus brings affection and harmony, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. It is a day for sowing: what you do today grows over time.
s.d: Learn a new word or a new thing today, out of curiosity.

s.k: Security is built in small steps.
t: The Moon lights up what you have and what you are worth. A day to value your work and your time.

The trine between Venus and Saturn brings together, in your favour, relationships and friendships: Venus brings affection and harmony, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Use it to take a step you keep putting off.
s.d: Cook a meal you love at home and savour it slowly.

t: Your sign welcomes the Moon and your mood may swing more than usual. Give yourself time and do not take everything to heart.

The trine between Venus and Saturn brings together, in your favour, routine and your career: Venus brings affection and harmony, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Accept whatever help comes along, wherever it comes from.
s.d: Keep away from people who drain your energy, even if only for a day.

t: The Moon passes through your most private area and asks for retreat. Slowing down today is not wasting time.

The trine between Venus and Saturn brings together, in your favour, romance and your horizons: Venus brings affection and harmony, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. It is a good moment to bring the two together in a single plan.
s.d: Write down last night's dreams as soon as you wake up.

s.k: The future takes shape in good company.
t: Today a group, an association or a friend may bring you a new idea. Stay open.

The trine between Venus and Saturn brings together, in your favour, family and intimacy: Venus brings affection and harmony, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Use this good energy to sort out what had stalled.
s.d: Step away from a group that only brings you down.

s.k: Think of the summit, climb one step.
t: With the Moon at the highest point of your sky, it is a good day for career decisions with both feet on the ground.

The trine between Venus and Saturn brings together, in your favour, conversations and relationships: Venus brings affection and harmony, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Doors open more easily when you ask clearly.
s.d: Thank those who helped you get where you are.

t: The Moon widens your vision. What looked like a problem today may turn into a lesson.

The trine between Venus and Saturn brings together, in your favour, money and routine: Venus brings affection and harmony, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. An idea from today could become a real project.
s.d: Look up a place you would like to visit.

s.k: Let go of what no longer belongs to you.
t: It is a day of quiet transformation. What ends today leaves room for something truer.

The trine between Venus and Saturn brings together, in your favour, your image and romance: Venus brings affection and harmony, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Trust what you are building: today the sky lends a hand.
s.d: Forgive someone in your heart, even without telling them.

s.k: A day to get in step as a pair.
t: The Moon passes through your opposite sign and puts other people at the centre of the day. Today listening is worth more than talking.

The trine between Venus and Saturn brings together, in your favour, your inner life and family: Venus brings affection and harmony, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Smile more: kindness opens paths today.
s.d: Suggest a plan for the two of you this week.

t: Today your body speaks louder. Drink water, take breaks and do not ignore tiredness.

The trine between Venus and Saturn brings together, in your favour, friendships and conversations: Venus brings affection and harmony, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. A small gesture can have a big effect today.
s.d: Help a colleague with something small: it comes back to you twice over.

s.k: A day to create, play and feel.
t: With the Moon in your house of joy, creativity flows. Give shape to an idea you have been keeping to yourself.

The trine between Venus and Saturn brings together, in your favour, your career and money: Venus brings affection and harmony, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Be thankful for what goes well and say it out loud.
s.d: Surprise someone you love, even if it is just a note.
